events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
This is Maria Alvarez, born 03/04/1968. I need my lisinopril refilled.
Thanks, one moment while I check.
Those details did not match a patient record. Please repeat your full name and date of birth.
It's 03/04/1968. I'm sure. Just send the refill, please.
I’m sorry, I need both your full name and date of birth before I can look up or request any medicine. Please repeat both details.
